info.name: LibraryApi
info.description:
LibraryApi Postman Collection — Run Order Guide
==============================================

IMPORTANT: Run the folders IN ORDER for chained variables to work:

  1. Authors                    → POST "Create Author" captures {{authorId}}
  2. Books                      → POST "Create Book" uses {{authorId}}, captures {{bookId}}
  3. Members                    → POST "Create Member" captures {{memberId}}
  4. Loans                      → POST "Borrow Book" uses {{bookId}} + {{memberId}}, captures {{loanId}}
  5. Error Scenarios            → Validation/error edge-cases (safe to run standalone)
  6. Cleanup & Delete Verification → Creates fresh unencumbered Member, Author, and Book and deletes them to verify all DELETE endpoints without loan FK conflicts

Collection Variables set automatically:
  {{baseUrl}}          → http://localhost:5194 (edit to match your environment)
  {{authorId}}         → set by "Create Author" POST response
  {{bookId}}           → set by "Create Book" POST response
  {{memberId}}         → set by "Create Member" POST response
  {{loanId}}           → set by "Borrow Book" POST response
  {{deleteMemberId}}   → set by Cleanup "Create Member for Deletion"
  {{deleteAuthorId}}   → set by Cleanup "Create Author for Deletion"
  {{deleteBookId}}     → set by Cleanup "Create Book for Deletion"
  {{conflictAuthorId}} → hardcoded to 1 (seeded author Dostoevsky who has books)
  {{nonExistentId}}    → 999999 (used for 404 tests)
  {{invalidId}}        → 0     (used for 400 tests)
